requests.name: Moonroot Conservatory
requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original OathFront tactical card game battlefield environment backdrop, wide 16:9. Elevated near-top-down camera, symmetrical readable central rectangular platform occupying the middle 76 percent width and 70 percent height. Rich decorative world architecture only at corners and outer rim, generous uncluttered dark low-contrast central surface to overlay five vertical gameplay lanes and cards later. Premium hand-painted stylized 3D fantasy game environment, faceted materials and cinematic indirect light. No cards, no characters, no text, no logos, no UI borders/buttons, no drawn lane grid, no labels, no watermarks. Opaque background. Theme: Ancient glass-roof conservatory at moonrise, jade foliage, curling roots, turquoise lantern pods and soft moon flowers around the outside edge; worn dark mossy stone platform in the middle. Calm deep emerald and slate palette.
